read.title: Introducing Our K-Beauty Skincare Line
read.text:
Dear Ms. Haddad,

My name is Minsu Lee, and I work in overseas sales at Lumora Cosmetics in Seoul. I'm reaching out to introduce our skincare brand.

Our product range covers sheet masks, toners, and sunscreens made with gentle ingredients. Our best-seller, the Calming Cica Mask, is now sold in eight countries.

I noticed that your stores focus on clean beauty, so I believe our line would be a good fit for your customers. I have attached our catalog and price list.

Would you be available for a short call next week?

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
qs: Minsu가 이 회사에 연락한 이유로 든 것은?

write.task: 인터넷에서 찾은 말레이시아 화장품 유통사에 처음 연락하는 메일을 써 보세요. 회사와 제품을 짧게 소개하고, 그 회사에 잘 맞는 이유와 카탈로그 첨부, 통화 요청을 담아 보세요.
write.en: Write a first email to a Malaysian cosmetics distributor: introduce your company and products, say why they are a good fit, attach a catalog, and ask for a call.
hints: would be a good fit for
write.model:
Dear Mr. Tan,

I'm reaching out to introduce Lumora Cosmetics, a K-beauty brand from Seoul. Our product range includes toners, serums, and sunscreens. Our best-seller is a light daily sunscreen for hot weather. Since your shops serve many young customers, I believe it would be a good fit for your market. Please see our catalog attached. Could we have a short call next week?

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
